title: SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO Details
intro:
SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO is a book build issue of ₹42.52 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 32.56 lakh shares aggregating to ₹38.42 crores and offer for sale of 3.48 lakh shares aggregating to ₹4.11 crores.

SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO opens for subscription on Sep 17, 2026 and closes on Sep 21, 2026. The allotment for the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 22, 2026. SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 24, 2026.

SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO is set issue price band at ₹112 to ₹118 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,83,200 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹4,24,800.

Indcap Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

Updated on Sep 11, 2026 Incorporated in 2009, Spectraa Technology Solutions Limited provides engineering, designing, fabrication, installation, commissioning and decommissioning greenfield and brownfield projects across various industries which include, Breweries (Craft and Microbreweries), Distilleries, Food and Beverages, Malt Spirit and Blending, Extraction Plants, FMCG (Fast Moving Consumer Goods) and Pharmaceuticals. It primarily caters to the following product verticals: 1. Commercial Brewery Equipment: Turnkey brewhouse and cellar systems for commercial-scale beer brewing, fermentation, conditioning, and storage. 2. Distillery Equipment: Copper pot still–based turnkey distillation systems to separate and concentrate alcohol and flavour compounds for spirits. 3. Food and Beverages Plants: Process equipment and integrated utilities/packaging interfaces for extracting and processing flavour and colour from plant-based inputs. 4. Microbrewery Equipment: Turnkey brewhouse and cellar systems for craft/micro-scale beer brewing, fermentation, conditioning, and storage. 5. Malt Spirit Equipment: Turnkey milling-to-distillation equipment trains for producing malt spirit from malted grains, including wash/spirit stills, condensers, and blending/storage tanks. 6. Extraction Plant: Extraction vessels with holding/buffer tanks. The company have two manufacturing facilities located at Bengaluru and Jaipur with an aggregate built up area of 33,214.75 square feet. As on the date of DRHP, it has partnered with more than across India and international market. faqs.question: How to apply in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
